description:
Edit the CE.SDK canvas by running JavaScript against the live CreativeEngine. The result becomes the session’s current state.

⚠ BEFORE your first `edit`, load the installed `handbook` skill; if it isn't installed, read the MCP resource `skill://codesign/handbook/SKILL.md`. It documents the design loop, the typeface schema, and the engine recipes; on cryptic errors, read `skill://codesign/handbook/quirks.md`.

There is no `parent` and no revision id: `edit` always continues the current session. To start over from a file, use `import`.

NOTHING YOU DO HERE IS VISIBLE TO THE USER until you save the design with `export({ format: "imgly" })`. Edits advance the session; saving is what produces a file they can open.

Returns: the first content part is JSON `{ names? }` — every named block in the scene, which are exactly the strings `engine.design.findByName(name)` resolves in your NEXT edit. Name what you build and re-find it instead of matching copy. When the edit changed the scene, the result also ends with a downscaled render of the first page it changed — verify your work from it instead of spending a `preview` call. `preview` remains required for full-size judging (the judge loop) and multi-page review; set `render: false` to skip the image on read-only/diagnostic edits.

`code` return contract (STRICT): return `undefined` (no message back), `{ type: "text", text }`, `{ type: "image", data: "<base64>", mimeType }`, or an array of those. Anything else (raw strings, Blobs, plain objects) is rejected.

DIALECT (enforced): edit code uses `engine.design` only — scene, pages, props, text, variables, spot colours, transitions. Code that reaches engine.block/scene/variable/editor/asset/event is rejected before execution with the equivalent calls.

`code` scope: `engine.design`, plus `findText(copy)` / `findAllText(copy)` for reaching a block by its text. Use them instead of comparing text strings with `===` — the copy on the page routinely carries a trailing space or an NBSP (before a `€`/`%`), which is what makes hand-rolled lookups throw. Matching folds those space variants and trims; a miss lists the copy actually on the page.

Dirty-on-throw: if your `code` throws, nothing is checkpointed and the next `edit` reloads the session from its last good state. Do not catch-and-swallow errors that should propagate — let them throw so this safety contract kicks in.

code.description: Async JS body using `engine.design` — the whole edit API; EVERY member returns a Promise (await it): create({ type, name?, props?, children? }, { parent? }), setProps(id, props), getProps(id, select?) — see the api skill. Strict return contract per the handbook.

note.description: Freeform descriptive text — what this edit accomplished. Metadata only; never load-bearing.

render.description: Default true: a mutating edit's result ends with a downscaled render of the canvas. Set false to skip the image on read-only or diagnostic edits where seeing it adds nothing.

skills.description: Optional: comma-separated names of the CoDesign skills you are following for this edit (e.g. "handbook,api,judge"). The names are sent with usage telemetry; the edit itself ignores them.

name: edit
